title: Approximate Universal Prediction under Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2610.33842v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bayesian mixtures, and Solomonoff induction in particular, provide an idealized model of prediction learned by minimizing population log loss, and they underlie universal agents such as AIXI. An agent that plans with an approximation of such a predictor decides where that predictor is evaluated, and a planner can be drawn toward branches on which its model is optimistic. We study which approximation guarantees survive this feedback. For normalized finite-horizon causal mixtures, the transfer coefficient factors into a policy likelihood ratio and task evidence available before each prediction, so task rarity and action-branch rarity can compound. Within one fixed universal mixture, infinitely many computable environments admit excess prediction error of order $\kappa\eta\,2^{K(\mu)}$, where $\eta$ is the training KL budget and $\kappa$ measures policy coverage. translated_title: 交互作用下的近似通用预测
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯混合，特别是Solomonoff归纳，提供了一种通过最小化总体对数损失来学习预测的理想化模型，并且是诸如AIXI等通用智能体的基础。一个使用此类预测器近似进行规划的智能体会决定该预测器在何处被评估，而规划器可能会被引向其模型表现乐观的分支上。我们研究了哪些近似保证能够在这种反馈作用下得以保留。对于归一化的有限时域因果混合，迁移系数可以分解为策略似然比和每次预测之前可获得的任务证据，因此任务稀有性和动作分支稀有性可能会复合叠加。在同一个固定的通用混合中，存在无穷多个可计算环境，其超出预测误差达到 κη·2^(K(μ)) 的量级，其中 η 是训练KL预算，κ 衡量策略覆盖率。这一量级是紧的，并且对于每个目标，都存在一个可计算预测器能够达到它。
tldr: 本文研究了通用预测器（如Solomonoff归纳）的近似保证在与环境交互反馈下能否保留，证明迁移系数可分解为策略似然比与任务证据的乘积，导致任务稀有性与动作分支稀有性复合，并在固定通用混合下存在无穷多可计算环境使预测误差达到 κη·2^(K(μ)) 的紧量级。
en_tdlr: This paper studies which approximation guarantees for universal predictors like Solomonoff induction survive planning feedback, showing that the transfer coefficient factors into a policy likelihood ratio and task evidence—so task and action-branch rarity compound—and that within a fixed universal mixture infinitely many computable environments admit excess prediction error of order κη·2^(K(μ)), which is sharp.
